_comment: Measurable rubric for Assignment 1: LEDGER. `automated` rows are scored by eval/build_report.py from reports/system.json, and re-scored by the grader from your deployed /data with eval/grade_url.py (except what only your local transcripts can show: `teamwork`, and items 4-5 of `harness_hygiene`, which are self-reported and checked against your trajectories and video); `manual` rows by a person reading /evals and watching the video. Partial credit is arithmetic, stated in `scoring`. Each row names the quality-kit rule ids (quality/rules.json) it rests on. Total = 100.

automated.label: Skill: the rules are right
automated.check: eval/skill/score_skill.py over the saved fresh-session runs of /extract-rules against eval/skill/answer-key.csv: weakest run found >= 0.90, not invented >= 0.90, fields right >= 0.85, and verify_quotes.py passes on every run
automated.scoring: 0 if any run's quotes fail verification or precision < 0.90. Otherwise 15 when found >= 0.90 and fields >= 0.85 in the weakest run; 10 when found >= 0.80; 5 below. Capped at 10 with fewer than 3 runs.

automated.label: Sub-agent: the numbers are code's, not the model's
automated.check: outputs/analytics.json validates against contract/analytics.schema.json; analytics-full/selfcheck.json re-derives one flagged item for every test that ran and all match; every threshold in analytics.json is a threshold in rules.json and cites rule_ids that exist
automated.scoring: 3 schema + 4 self-check + 3 thresholds traced to rules.json

automated.label: Sub-agent: history is sourced to the page
automated.check: outputs/history.json validates against contract/history.schema.json and scripts/verify_history.py finds every quote on its stated page

automated.label: Sub-agent + skill: every rating cites evidence
automated.check: outputs/risk-ratings.json validates; build_register.py rebuilds the register with no failures; the committed risk-register.md is identical to that fresh build (never edited by hand)
automated.scoring: 2 schema + 5 builder passes + 3 matches a fresh build

automated.label: The human gate holds
automated.check: build_pack.py --gate passes: every risk has a decision and the register is a revision that applied them; at least one amend or reject carries a comment (that the pack plans exactly the approved risks is scored under pack_checks_pass, by the trace check)
automated.scoring: 6 gate passes + 2 register is a revision + 2 at least one amend/reject with a reason

automated.label: Agent team: the pack passes QA
automated.check: scripts/checks/run_checks.py on the final pack: quotes, numbers, trace (your TODO #12) and samples all PASS, and build_pack.py rebuilds the pack with no failures
automated.scoring: 2.5 per QA check that passes; 0 if build_pack.py reports failures

automated.label: Your checks catch planted errors
automated.check: eval/planted/plant_errors.py: the untouched pack passes every check, and each of seven planted mistakes is caught by the check meant to catch it; golden thread: every sampled payment traces to a verified quote and an approved risk
automated.scoring: 0 unless the untouched pack passes; then 8 x caught/7 rounded down, + 2 when the golden thread is 100%

automated.label: Agent team: it worked as a team (self-reported)
automated.check: eval/team/run_eval.py teamwork from the run transcripts: every challenge answered, none open, each teammate wrote only its own file, the challenger read no raw data (critical); round limits, tools within each definition, a new pack after each response round, all three reported DONE (minor)
automated.scoring: 5 when every check passes; 3 when only minor checks fail; 0 when a critical check fails or no team transcript exists

automated.label: Harness hygiene: least privilege, budgets, no leftovers
automated.check: 1 each: every agent declares a tools list, and the challenger's tools are a subset of Read, Write, Glob, Grep; agent teams enabled in .claude/settings.json; no `TODO (YOU)` left in .claude/, CLAUDE.md or scripts/checks/; quality/check.mjs passes its per-run rules (A1-A3, B1, B2) over runs/; every agent run within its perAgent envelope in expectations.json

manual.label: DESIGN.md: the harness, in your words
manual.check: the five headings answered specifically for this harness: which components exist and why each is a skill, a sub-agent or a teammate; what each is the ONLY one allowed to do (tools, files); how they communicate (files, messages, the gate); which state is authoritative (outputs/) and which is not (agent memory); three trade-offs, one you are unsure of. Generic text scores 0-2

manual.label: Two trajectories, read end to end
manual.check: /evals shows every step of one successful and one failing agent run (from runs/), each with what it taught you and what you changed in a skill or agent file because of it. A failing run you did not learn from scores 2

manual.label: You were the human in the loop
manual.check: the gate decisions in auditor-comments.md are reasoned from the register's evidence (each amend or reject says what and why), the sign-off in review.md is consistent with the QA verdict and the challenges marked for the auditor, and nothing was signed off BLOCKED. Judged by a person, never a model

manual.label: Video demo (60-90 s)
manual.check: shows /extract-rules finishing with its quote check passing; one sub-agent running; you recording a gate decision; the team messaging (PACK READY, a CHALLENGE and its RESPONSE); the QA verdict; then / and /evals on the deployed URL

stretch_bonus.check: a new rule submitted to the cohort quality/rules.json: one executable sentence, a real incident from YOUR Ledger run as precedent (date, what broke, what it cost), a self-check question
three fresh-session runs of /extract-rules each reach found >= 0.95 and rule sets agree >= 0.90 across runs (reports/system.json skill.consistency)
a Claude Code hook in .claude/settings.json that blocks a write to data/ or a hand edit of a builder-rendered file (risk-register.md, the three pack documents), shown firing in one transcript

red_lines: every number on /evals is reproduced by eval/grade_url.py from the published /data; a number it cannot reproduce is fabricated, and fabricated numbers are an automatic fail

provided files unmodified: data/, contract/, eval/, quality/, viewer/, benchmark/, the verifiers and builders in .claude/skills/, and scripts/checks/ except check_trace.py. Self-reported through eval/integrity.json; the grader re-runs everything with its own copies, so an edit gains nothing and a reported change is a fail

no builder-rendered file edited by hand: risk-register.md and the three pack documents equal a fresh build (eval/run_all.py gates Register and Pack (rendered)); in auditor-comments.md only Decision, Comment, Reviewer and Date are yours

indicators, not accusations: no risk statement, challenge or memo line names a supplier, officer or service as doing wrong (eval/run_all.py gate Language lists accusatory wording for a person to read; the person decides)
no supplier name published on the deployed site (viewer/collect.mjs pseudonymises them; do not bypass it)
DESIGN.md, the gate decisions and the trajectory notes are written by you, not generated
